code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Full rows and columns of the frame color divide the grid into rooms.
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    frame = grid[sep_rows[0]][0] if sep_rows else grid[0][sep_cols[0]]
    rb = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    cb = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    freq = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != frame)
    background = freq.most_common(1)[0][0]
    marker = next((v for v in freq if v != background), None)
    # A room containing a pair of markers is encoded as 1; otherwise retain
    # the background color, as shown by both demonstrations.
    out = []
    for i in range(len(rb)-1):
        row = []
        for j in range(len(cb)-1):
            vals = [grid[r][c] for r in range(rb[i]+1, rb[i+1])
                    for c in range(cb[j]+1, cb[j+1])]
            count = sum(v == marker for v in vals) if marker is not None else 0
            row.append(1 if count == 2 else background)
        out.append(row)
    return out
'''
